title: Preview is collapsed to a one-line summary, expandable to a week-by-week breakdown with skipped days struck through and their reasons
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. You are on the spread step for a multi-week scope that will skip at least one weekend.
steps: 1. Read the preview area without expanding it.
3. Find a skipped day in the breakdown.
expected: 1. Collapsed: a one-line summary in the spirit of the spec's example '20 shifts · Jun 15 to Jul 13 · skips weekends + 2 days'.
2. Expanded: a week-by-week breakdown of the planned shifts.
3. Skipped days are struck through and show the reason they are skipped (weekend / closure).
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
notes: Preview one-liner ('N shifts · <start> → <end> · skips weekends + N closures', expandable week-by-week) pinned by the Claude design (§4b); confirm the exact copy live. Driver: Claude design §4b. TECH-PLAN 2026-07-29 CONFLICT FLAG (NQ-1): plan Phase 7 SpreadDialog includes 'real closure skip' in the preview - whether a closure appears as a struck-through skipped day in V1 depends on the NQ-1 ruling.
